page.overview:
Who is Briyakar Jurrell?

, better known as just Jurrell, was an elf member of the Claret Orders that later became one of The Tombtakers.

Jurrell was an elven woman with brown skin covered in piercings. As of 831 PD her head was shaved, and she had runics tattoos. Her teeth were filed to points and she had an immense jewel pierced into her navel.

She had a refined behavior acquired in proper cities, around proper folk. She used to brag about her talent stealing. She was ambitious.

Jurrell was born in Yardel, in a community of elven jewelers that soon became impoverished. She and her family moved to Nogvurot seeking a better life. She maintained an interest in jewelry, and at some point began to steal it, increasing her mastery of the activity to the point where she infiltrated Rexxentrum as a handmaiden of Queen Duvia Dwendal, stealing an immense royal jewel from her, and becoming wanted by imperial decree.
